module.name: Grant Programs / Opportunities, Workflow Engines, Products

screens.name: Create Opportunity Guided Flow (فرصة منح جديدة)
Opportunity Detail - shell & Summary tab (عرض فرصة المنح / الملخص)
Basic Information & Targeting tab (المعلومات الأساسية / الجمعيات المستهدفة)
RFP Project Details tab (تفاصيل المشروع) - RFP only
Offers & Award tab (العروض والترسية) - RFP only
Workflow Engine Detail & Editor (تفاصيل محرك سير الإجراء)
Configuration Edit Session bar & Evidence dialog (وضع التعديل / تأكيد التعديلات)

epics.name: Opportunity Lifecycle Management
epics.description: Create, list, publish, open/close and maintain grant opportunities (project, product, RFP), including general vs initiative-specific opportunities.

epics.name: Eligibility & Targeting
epics.description: Define who may apply to an opportunity (classification, region, governance, named partners/groups, account types, quota) and evaluate partner eligibility.

epics.name: Opportunity Workflow & Evaluation Configuration
epics.description: Per-opportunity stages, approval types, committee, SLA, supervisors, permissions, criteria, pass score, form and post-approval defaults.

epics.name: Workflow Engine Library
epics.description: Reusable workflow templates copied into opportunities, with engine-level performance analytics.

epics.name: Product Grants & Catalog
epics.description: Organization product catalog, stock control, linking products to product opportunities, and product movement analytics.

epics.name: RFP (Tendered Projects) & Invitations
epics.description: Donor-defined projects, private invitations to partners, offer comparison and award to a single offer.

epics.name: Configuration Governance & Performance Insight
epics.description: Evidence-backed edit sessions with rollback/history, and opportunity summary/stage statistics.

features.name: Opportunity List & Portfolio KPIs
features.description: List of all grant opportunities with reception status, publication and KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: All opportunities are listed with correct open/closed status.
Publish switch persists and affects portal visibility.

features.name: Guided Opportunity Creation
features.description: Four-step wizard (with optional AI assist) that creates an opportunity with a default workflow and criteria.
acceptance_criteria: An opportunity cannot be created without valid title, budget and window.
Created opportunity has default stages and criteria.

features.name: Opportunity Basic Info, Publication & Reception Window
features.description: Detail page shell and Basic Info tab to maintain identity, budget, quota, dates, publication and active status.
acceptance_criteria: Saved values persist and drive portal visibility.
Closing via 'نشطة' removes the opportunity from the portal open list.

features.name: General vs Initiative-Specific Opportunity
features.description: Flag an opportunity as general so the applicant chooses the annual-plan initiative; otherwise the opportunity's default plan item applies.
acceptance_criteria: A general opportunity forces initiative selection at application.
A specific opportunity's applications carry its default plan level.

features.name: Eligibility Targeting & Quota
features.description: Targeting rules, eligibility evaluation and per-partner application quota.
acceptance_criteria: Ineligible partners see reasons and cannot apply.
Named/group partners are always eligible.

features.name: Stage Configuration
features.description: Per-opportunity stage settings: approval type, committee, SLA, supervisors, permission flags.
acceptance_criteria: Stage settings drive the review actions and tasks.
Committee stages route to the secretary.

features.name: Evaluation Criteria & Pass Score
features.description: Weighted criteria and pass score used by reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Criteria and pass score are saved and used in evaluation.
Weight total is visibly flagged when not 100%.

features.name: Application Form Assignment
features.description: Choose an application form from the organization library for the opportunity.
acceptance_criteria: The selected form's fields appear in the portal application dialog.

features.name: Post-Approval Defaults
features.description: Defaults used when transferring approved applications to contracts/projects.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer applies the configured defaults.

features.name: Workflow Engine Library & Editor
features.description: Organization library of reusable workflow templates with a basic editor.
acceptance_criteria: Engines can be created and edited; used engines cannot be deleted.

features.name: Apply Engine to Opportunity
features.description: Copy an engine's stages, criteria and pass score into an opportunity.
acceptance_criteria: After applying, opportunity configuration matches the engine.

features.name: Engine Performance Analytics
features.description: Usage and per-stage performance of an engine across opportunities.
acceptance_criteria: Stage metrics match status history.

features.name: Product Catalog & Stock
features.description: Organization catalog of in-kind products with price, unit and stock, and stock movements on approval/delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Stock decreases on final approval.
Requests above stock are rejected at submission.

features.name: Opportunity Product Linking
features.description: Choose which catalog products a product opportunity offers.
acceptance_criteria: Only linked products are requestable in the portal.

features.name: Product Movement Analytics
features.description: Historical movement of a product by month, opportunity and region.
acceptance_criteria: Figures reconcile with application items.

features.name: Targeted Invitations
features.description: Private invitations to named/group-targeted partners with status tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Each targeted partner receives exactly one invitation.
Status reflects partner response.

features.name: RFP Project Definition
features.description: Donor-defined project specification for RFP opportunities.
acceptance_criteria: Totals validated; ceiling enforced.

features.name: Offer Comparison & Award
features.description: Compare RFP offers and award one, creating contract/project automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one offer can be awarded.
Losing offers are closed with an apology.

features.name: Evidence-Backed Configuration Edit Sessions
features.description: View-by-default editing of opportunities, engines and product catalog with mandatory evidence, rollback and history.
acceptance_criteria: No configuration change is committed without evidence.
Cancel restores the previous configuration.

features.name: Opportunity Summary & Stage Statistics
features.description: Opportunity-level performance dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Summary figures reconcile with applications.

requirements.statement: The system shall list all grant opportunities with title, kind badge, targeted badge, reception window, budget, reception status, publish switch, application count and a view action.
acceptance_criteria: Each opportunity row shows the 8 columns described.
Clicking the eye icon opens /programs/$id.

requirements.statement: The system shall display KPI cards: number of opportunities, total applications and total budgets.
acceptance_criteria: KPI 'إجمالي المنح (الميزانيات)' equals the sum of opportunity budgets in SAR format.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute each opportunity's reception status as open ('مفتوحة') or closed ('مغلقة') per BR-PRG-02.
acceptance_criteria: An active, published opportunity within its window shows 'مفتوحة'.
An unpublished or closed-status or out-of-window opportunity shows 'مغلقة'.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorised staff to publish or unpublish an opportunity from the list.
acceptance_criteria: Toggling the switch persists 'published' and the reception status updates.
Unpublished opportunities disappear from the partner portal's open list.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a four-step guided creation flow: identity (title, kind, description), dates & budget (+general flag), default workflow preview, review & create.
acceptance_criteria: The flow shows four steps in order with a Back button from step 2.
The review step lists title, kind, budget, window, general flag and stage/criteria counts.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent progressing past a step until it is valid per BR-PRG-03.
acceptance_criteria: With a 1-character title, Next is disabled.
With close_at <= open_at, the message 'نهاية الاستقبال يجب أن تكون بعد البداية' appears and Next is disabled.

requirements.statement: The system shall let the user describe the opportunity in free text and receive AI-proposed values for title, kind, description, budget and dates, applied only on user confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Applying the AI proposal fills only the fields returned.
Nothing is saved until the user completes the flow.

requirements.statement: On completion the system shall create the opportunity with defaults (BR-PRG-04), the default 3-stage workflow and 3 criteria (BR-PRG-05), then open the opportunity detail.
acceptance_criteria: After creation the opportunity has 3 stages and 3 criteria totalling 100%.
The user lands on /programs/<new id> with toast 'أُنشئت الفرصة'.

requirements.statement: The system shall create new opportunities as unpublished drafts and require an explicit publish action.
acceptance_criteria: A newly created opportunity is not visible in the partner portal until published.

requirements.statement: The system shall present an opportunity detail page with tabs: Summary, Basic Info, Products (product only), Project Details and Offers (RFP only), Invitations, Defaults, Workflow, Criteria, Form, plus configuration history.
acceptance_criteria: A product opportunity shows the 'المنتجات' tab and no RFP tabs.
An RFP opportunity shows 'تفاصيل المشروع' and 'العروض والترسية'.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow editing basic information: title, description, budget, max applications per partner, announcement date, reception start/end (date-time), target account types, eligibility text, published and active flags; deadline is derived from close_at.
acceptance_criteria: Saving updates the opportunity and shows 'تم حفظ بيانات الفرصة'.
deadline equals the date part of the new close_at.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow staff to close or reactivate an opportunity via the 'نشطة' switch (status active/closed).
acceptance_criteria: Setting 'نشطة' off and saving sets status 'closed' and the opportunity shows 'مغلقة'.
Reactivating within the window and published shows 'مفتوحة'.

requirements.statement: The system shall validate on save that close_at is after open_at, budget > 0 and max applications per partner >= 1.
acceptance_criteria: Saving with close_at before open_at is rejected with a clear message.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow marking an opportunity as general ('فرصة عامة' - not linked to a specific initiative) at creation.
acceptance_criteria: Checking 'فرصة عامة' stores open_track=true and the review step shows 'نعم'.

requirements.statement: For a general opportunity the portal shall require the applicant to choose an annual-plan initiative; for an initiative-specific opportunity the application shall inherit the opportunity's default plan level.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting to a general opportunity without an initiative shows 'اختر المبادرة التي يندرج تحتها الطلب'.
An application to a specific opportunity gets plan_level_id = default_plan_level_id.

requirements.statement: The system shall display the general/specific flag on the list and detail and allow changing it while no applications exist.
acceptance_criteria: The detail page shows whether the opportunity is general.
Changing the flag is blocked once an application exists.

requirements.statement: The system shall let staff define targeting: partner groups, NCNP classification groups, sub-classifications, regions, governorates/cities, minimum governance score and named partners, with a live textual summary.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting region 'منطقة الرياض' limits governorate options to partners in that region.
Clearing all fields shows 'مفتوحة لجميع الجمعيات'.

requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate a partner's eligibility for an opportunity per BR-PRG-07 to BR-PRG-11 and return the list of failed-rule reasons.
acceptance_criteria: A named partner is eligible regardless of region/classification.
A partner outside the targeted region gets reason 'مخصصة لـ: <regions>'.

requirements.statement: The partner portal shall list open opportunities, show quota usage ('قدّمت x من y') and disable application with reasons when ineligible or quota exhausted.
acceptance_criteria: An ineligible partner sees the reasons in red and no 'تقديم طلب' button.
A partner at quota sees 'استنفدت عدد الطلبات المسموحة'.

requirements.statement: The system shall flag targeted opportunities in the list with a 'مستهدفة' badge and a summary tooltip.
acceptance_criteria: An opportunity with any targeting rule shows the badge.

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce open window, eligibility and quota server-side when an application is submitted.
acceptance_criteria: A submission to a closed or non-eligible opportunity is rejected by the server even if the UI is bypassed.

requirements.statement: The system shall show each stage of the opportunity and allow editing approval type, SLA days, supervisors (staff personas) and permission flags (return, close, skip, edit, request edit, attach).
acceptance_criteria: Changing SLA to 7 and leaving the field saves sla_days=7.
Turning off 'السماح بالإغلاق' hides the Reject action on the review screen for that stage.

requirements.statement: For committee stages the system shall capture committee name and committee secretary.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting 'موافقة لجنة' reveals committee name and secretary fields.
Applications in that stage appear in the secretary's tasks.

requirements.statement: The review workflow shall honour stage flags and SLA (see module REV).
acceptance_criteria: allow_skip=true shows 'تخطي' on the review page.
Days in stage above SLA show 'متأخر'.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent structural workflow changes (approval type, stage set, criteria) once applications exist, or version them per application.
acceptance_criteria: Changing approval type on an opportunity with in-flight applications is blocked or creates a new version.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow adding (name + weight) and deleting evaluation criteria and show the weight total coloured green at 100% and red otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a criterion with empty name does nothing.
Total 90% is shown in red.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow setting the opportunity pass score (%).
acceptance_criteria: Changing pass score to 75 shows 'تم تحديث نسبة الاجتياز'.

requirements.statement: The system shall block publishing/committing when criteria weights do not total 100% or the pass score is outside 0-100.
acceptance_criteria: Commit with total 90% is rejected with a message.

requirements.statement: The system shall let staff choose one application form from the organization's form library (or none) and preview its fields read-only.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a form saves form_id and shows 'تم ربط النموذج بالفرصة'.
The preview lists field labels, type labels and required markers.

requirements.statement: The system shall let staff configure post-approval defaults: contract required (non-product only), default project manager, contract officer, default annual-plan item.
acceptance_criteria: The contract switch is hidden for product opportunities.
Selecting 'غير محدد' stores null.

requirements.statement: When an approved application is transferred, the system shall apply the opportunity defaults per BR-PRG-27 (see module PRJ).
acceptance_criteria: With has_contract=false the transfer creates a project without a contract.
With no default manager the first project_manager persona is assigned.

requirements.statement: The system shall list the organization's workflow engines with stage count, criteria count, pass score and number of opportunities using each.
acceptance_criteria: Each engine row shows the 5 data columns and a view icon.
Empty library shows 'لا توجد محركات بعد.'

requirements.statement: The system shall create an engine from a name with defaults per BR-PRG-22 and open its detail page.
acceptance_criteria: Creating 'محرك تجريبي' adds an engine with 3 stages and pass 70%.
Blank name does nothing.

requirements.statement: In edit mode the system shall allow renaming an engine, changing each stage's SLA, and adding/deleting criteria with weight-total indicator.
acceptance_criteria: The editor is visible only in edit mode.
Deleting a criterion updates the criteria count.

requirements.statement: The system shall delete an engine only when no opportunity uses it (BR-PRG-21).
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a used engine shows 'لا يمكن حذف محرك تستخدمه فرص'.
Deleting an unused engine returns to the library.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow editing engine description, pass score, stage names, approval types and number of stages, with versioning.
acceptance_criteria: An engine pass score can be edited and saved.

requirements.statement: The system shall let staff select an engine and apply it to an opportunity after confirmation, replacing stages and criteria per BR-PRG-19.
acceptance_criteria: After applying, the opportunity's stages/criteria equal the engine's and pass score equals the engine's.
Supervisors of stage n are preserved.

requirements.statement: The system shall warn or block engine application when applications/evaluations exist and shall preserve committee settings and stage flags.
acceptance_criteria: Applying to an opportunity with evaluations shows a blocking warning.

requirements.statement: The engine detail shall show KPIs: opportunities using it, applications processed, approval rate, closure rate (closed/cancelled/awaiting apology) and average evaluation with pass rate.
acceptance_criteria: With 4 applications of which 1 approved, approval rate shows 25%.
Without evaluations, average shows '—'.

requirements.statement: The engine detail shall show per-stage performance: SLA, average actual duration (red when above SLA), current, late (with %), completed, returned and closed counts.
acceptance_criteria: A stage whose average duration exceeds SLA is shown in red.

requirements.statement: The engine detail shall list its criteria and the opportunities that use it with application counts and links.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking an opportunity opens /programs/$id.

requirements.statement: The system shall list the organization's product catalog with name, description, unit, unit price and stock.
acceptance_criteria: Each product shows unit and price in SAR and stock.
Empty catalog shows 'الكتالوج فارغ — أضف أول منتج.'

requirements.statement: In edit mode the system shall allow adding a product with name (required), description, unit (from a fixed list), unit price and stock quantity.
acceptance_criteria: Adding without a name shows 'اسم المنتج مطلوب'.
A valid add shows 'تمت إضافة المنتج إلى الكتالوج'.

requirements.statement: In edit mode the system shall allow inline editing of unit, unit price and stock, and deleting a product.
acceptance_criteria: Editing stock and leaving the field updates quantity_available.

requirements.statement: The system shall limit requested quantities to available stock at submission and deduct stock at final approval per BR-PRG-24/25, tracking delivery per BR-PRG-26.
acceptance_criteria: Final approval of 10 units reduces stock by 10 (not below 0).
The approved product application shows fulfillment 'بانتظار التسليم'.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent deleting products referenced by applications (archive instead) and shall block approval when stock is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a referenced product is refused.
Approving beyond stock is blocked with a message.

requirements.statement: For product opportunities the system shall allow selecting which catalog products are available, showing price/unit and stock for each.
acceptance_criteria: Checking a product creates a link; unchecking removes it.
Linked products are the only ones offered in the portal for that opportunity.

requirements.statement: The product detail shall show current stock, requested, approved and delivered quantities (with SAR value), number of partners and top requesting region.
acceptance_criteria: Requested value = requested quantity x unit price.

requirements.statement: The product detail shall show a monthly bar chart (requested/approved/delivered), a per-opportunity comparison, linked opportunities and the list of applications containing the product.
acceptance_criteria: With no requests the chart area shows 'لا توجد حركة بعد.'
Clicking an application opens /reviewer/$id.

requirements.statement: The system shall send invitations to all named and group-targeted partners not yet invited, showing the pending count, per BR-PRG-31.
acceptance_criteria: With 3 targets and 1 already invited the button shows '(2)' and sends 2 invitations.
With all targets invited the toast says 'كل الجهات المستهدفة مدعوة مسبقاً'.

requirements.statement: The system shall list invitations with partner name, email, sent date, partner account activation status, invitation status, copy-link and open actions.
acceptance_criteria: 'نسخ الرابط' copies <origin>/invite/<token>.
Status pill shows أُرسلت/فُتحت/قُدّم عرض/اعتذرت.

requirements.statement: The system shall update invitation status to opened on first link open, applied on application submission and declined on partner decline.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a 'sent' link sets status 'opened' with opened_at.
Submitting sets 'applied' with responded_at.

requirements.statement: The system shall deliver invitations by email using organization templates.
acceptance_criteria: Sending an invitation emails the partner contact.

requirements.statement: For RFP opportunities the system shall capture scope of work, deliverables, implementation duration, weighted activities (optionally payment-linked) and payment milestones (% of winning offer, due after N days), validating totals per BR-PRG-28.
acceptance_criteria: Saving activities totalling 90% shows 'مجموع أوزان الأنشطة يجب أن يكون 100%'.
Valid save shows 'تم حفظ تفاصيل المشروع'.

requirements.statement: The system shall present the opportunity budget as the financial ceiling and reject offers above it in the portal.
acceptance_criteria: An offer of budget+1 is rejected with 'العرض المالي يتجاوز السقف'.

requirements.statement: The system shall show offer cards with partner, reference, status or winner badge, financial offer (lowest marked), average evaluation score vs pass score, technical offer excerpt and a link to the offer.
acceptance_criteria: With 2+ offers the lowest shows 'الأقل'.
Unevaluated offers show 'لم يُقيّم'.

requirements.statement: The system shall award an RFP to one pending offer after confirmation, per BR-PRG-30, creating the contract/project and seeding activities and payments.
acceptance_criteria: After award the winner shows 'فائز' and other pending offers are closed with the apology reason.
A project with the RFP activities and payments exists for the winner.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow award only to offers that completed evaluation and passed, by an authorised role, in one atomic server transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Award of an unevaluated offer is refused.

requirements.statement: Configuration screens shall be view-only by default; 'تعديل' starts an edit session that snapshots the current configuration and enables controls.
acceptance_criteria: Without edit mode, basic-info inputs are disabled.
Clicking 'تعديل' shows the amber edit bar.

requirements.statement: Saving an edit session shall require an evidence document (note optional), detect no-change sessions, and log before/after snapshots with actor and evidence in config_edit_history.
acceptance_criteria: 'اعتماد وحفظ' is disabled until a file is attached.
Saving with no changes shows 'لا توجد تغييرات'.

requirements.statement: Cancelling an edit session shall restore the pre-edit snapshot of the entity (opportunity incl. stages/criteria/product links; engine; product catalog).
acceptance_criteria: After 'تراجع' the stages and criteria equal the state before 'تعديل'.

requirements.statement: The system shall show the configuration change history of the entity with date, actor, note and evidence file link.
acceptance_criteria: Each committed session appears with its evidence file name.

requirements.statement: The opportunity summary shall show applications, approved, closed, approved vs requested amount vs budget, and days remaining until close.
acceptance_criteria: After close_at the remaining card shows 'مغلقة'.

requirements.statement: The opportunity summary shall show applications per stage: current, late and average duration.
acceptance_criteria: Late count is shown in red when > 0.

requirements.statement: The opportunity summary shall show top 5 applicant partners, top 5 regions and, for product opportunities, requested vs delivered quantity per product.
acceptance_criteria: A product opportunity shows the products card.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to see all grant opportunities with their reception status, budget and application count so that I can monitor the portfolio.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active published opportunity whose window includes today, When I open the list, Then its status shows 'مفتوحة'.
Given an opportunity whose close_at has passed, When I open the list, Then its status shows 'مغلقة'.
Given 3 opportunities with budgets 1, 2, 3 M SAR, When I open the list, Then 'إجمالي المنح' shows 6,000,000 SAR.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to publish or unpublish an opportunity from the list so that I control its visibility to partners.
acceptance_criteria: Given a published open opportunity, When I switch publishing off, Then it shows 'مغلقة' and is not listed in the partner portal.
Given an unpublished opportunity within its window and active, When I switch publishing on, Then it shows 'مفتوحة'.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want a guided flow to create an opportunity with its kind, budget, reception window and a default workflow so that it is ready to configure in minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a title of one character, When I am on step 1, Then 'التالي' is disabled.
Given close_at earlier than open_at, When I am on step 2, Then an error message shows and 'التالي' is disabled.
Given valid inputs, When I click 'إنشاء الفرصة', Then I land on the new opportunity page and it has 3 stages and 3 criteria totalling 100%.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to describe a new opportunity in plain Arabic and get the fields proposed by AI so that I fill the form faster.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AI proposal containing budget 2,000,000, When I apply it, Then the budget field shows 2,000,000.
Given an applied proposal, When I close the dialog without finishing, Then no opportunity is created.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to edit an opportunity's basic information, quota and reception window so that it reflects the approved announcement.
acceptance_criteria: Given edit mode, When I change close_at and save, Then deadline equals the new close date.
Given view mode, When I open Basic Info, Then inputs are disabled.
Given [Recommended] close_at before open_at, When I save, Then the save is rejected.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to close an opportunity early or reactivate it so that I can stop or resume intake when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open opportunity, When I set 'نشطة' off and save, Then status becomes 'closed' and the portal no longer lists it.
Given a closed opportunity within its window and published, When I set 'نشطة' on and save, Then it is open again.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to mark an opportunity as general so that partners pick the initiative their request belongs to, while specific opportunities feed a fixed initiative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a general opportunity, When a partner submits without choosing an initiative, Then submission is refused with the initiative message.
Given a specific opportunity with default plan item X, When a partner submits, Then the application's plan_level_id is X.
Given [Recommended] an opportunity with applications, When I try to change the general flag, Then it is blocked.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to target an opportunity by classification, region, governorate, governance score, partner groups or named partners so that only intended partners can apply.
acceptance_criteria: Given I select classification 'التعليم والبحث', When I open sub-classification, Then only sub-classes of partners in that classification are offered.
Given no targeting values, When I view the summary, Then it reads 'مفتوحة لجميع الجمعيات'.
Given saved targeting, When I view the list, Then the opportunity shows the 'مستهدفة' badge.

stories.story: As a partner user I want to see which open opportunities I am eligible for and why not otherwise, and how many applications I have left, so that I apply only where I qualify.
acceptance_criteria: Given an opportunity targeting 'منطقة الرياض' and my partner in 'منطقة مكة المكرمة', When I view it, Then I see 'مخصصة لـ: منطقة الرياض' and no apply button.
Given max 1 application and one non-cancelled application already, When I view it, Then I see 'استنفدت عدد الطلبات المسموحة'.
Given my partner is named in the targeting, When I view it, Then I can apply.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want eligibility, reception window and quota enforced by the server so that no submission bypasses the rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given a closed opportunity, When a crafted request submits an application, Then the server rejects it.
Given an ineligible partner, When it opens /portal?apply=<id> and submits, Then the submission is rejected.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to set each stage's approval type, SLA, supervisors and allowed actions so that reviewers act within the agreed process.
acceptance_criteria: Given stage 2 with 'السماح بتخطي المرحلة' on, When a reviewer opens an application at stage 2, Then 'تخطي' is available.
Given SLA 5 days, When an application stays 6 days in the stage, Then it is shown late.
Given [Recommended] in-flight applications, When I change the approval type, Then the change is blocked or versioned.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to make a stage a committee approval with a named committee and secretary so that the committee decides via one minute.
acceptance_criteria: Given a committee stage with secretary S, When an application reaches the stage, Then it appears in S's tasks.
Given approval type 'موافقة لجنة', When I view the stage card, Then committee name and secretary fields are shown.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to maintain weighted evaluation criteria and a pass score so that applications are scored consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Given criteria totalling 100%, When I view the tab, Then the total is green.
Given pass score 75, When an evaluation totals 80, Then it is shown as passing.
Given [Recommended] total 90%, When I commit, Then commit is refused.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to attach a form from the organization library to the opportunity so that partners answer the right questions.
acceptance_criteria: Given I select form F, When a partner opens the application dialog, Then F's fields are shown.
Given a form with no fields, When I preview, Then 'النموذج لا يحتوي حقولاً بعد.' is shown.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to preset contract requirement, project manager, contract officer and plan item for an opportunity so that approved applications transfer without manual setup.
acceptance_criteria: Given has_contract off, When an approved application is transferred, Then no contract is created.
Given default manager M, When transferred, Then the project manager is M.
Given a product opportunity, When I open Defaults, Then the contract switch is hidden.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to browse and create workflow engines so that I have reusable process templates.

rules.rule: An opportunity has one kind: project (مشروع), product (منتجات) or rfp (مشروع مطروح). The kind is chosen at creation; no control exists to change it afterwards.
An opportunity is open for applications only when status='active' AND published=true AND now >= open_at (if set) AND now <= close_at (if set); otherwise it is shown as closed.
Creating an opportunity requires a title longer than 1 character, a budget > 0, and both reception dates with close_at strictly after open_at.

New opportunities are created with status='active', target_types=[جمعية أهلية, مؤسسة أهلية], deadline = date part of close_at; DB defaults apply for published (true), max_per_beneficiary (1) and pass_score (80).

Every new opportunity receives a default 3-stage workflow - (1) استقبال الطلبات 3 days, supervisor = first reviewer persona; (2) دراسة الطلبات 5 days, approval_type=criteria, supervisor = first reviewer; (3) اعتماد الطلبات 3 days, supervisor = first grants_manager - and 3 criteria: وضوح الأهداف 30%, الأثر المتوقع 40%, الجدوى المالية 30%.

General opportunity (open_track=true): not tied to one initiative - the applicant must select the annual-plan initiative when applying. Initiative-specific opportunity: the application inherits the opportunity's default plan level (default_plan_level_id).
A partner named explicitly (target_beneficiary_ids) or belonging to a targeted partner group (target_group_ids) is always eligible, bypassing all other targeting rules.
If an opportunity targets only named partners/groups and has no other targeting rule, every other partner is ineligible ('هذه الفرصة مخصصة لجمعيات محددة').

Other targeting rules are combined with AND; an empty list means 'all': account type, NCNP classification group, sub-classification, region, governorate (falls back to the partner's city), minimum governance score.
A partner without a governance score fails any minimum-governance rule (treated as -1).
Partner-group membership is resolved at check time, so adding a partner to a targeted group makes it eligible/invitable immediately.
A partner may hold at most max_per_beneficiary non-cancelled applications per opportunity.
Eligibility, reception window and quota are evaluated in the partner portal UI only; no database constraint or server-side check enforces them.

Each stage has an approval type: supervisor (المشرفين), criteria (معايير التقييم) or committee (موافقة لجنة). A committee stage carries a committee name and a secretary; its applications go to the secretary's tasks and are approved with one minute document.

Stage permission flags: allow_return (default true), allow_close (true), allow_skip (false), allow_edit (false), allow_request_edit (true), allow_attach (true). The review screen shows Return-for-edit, Reject, Skip and Return-to-previous according to these flags.
Each stage has an SLA in days; an application is late when days since stage_entered_at exceed the stage's sla_days.
Evaluation criteria weights are expected to total 100%; the total is shown green/red but saving is not blocked.
Each opportunity has a pass score (%); an evaluation/offer at or above it is shown as passing.

Applying an engine replaces all stages and criteria of the opportunity with copies from the engine: supervisors are kept per stage_no; engine approval types 'single'/'all' become 'supervisor'; allow_return/allow_close set true (other flags revert to DB defaults; committee name/secretary are lost); pass_score copied; workflow_template_id recorded.
Engines are copied, not referenced: later engine edits do not change opportunities that already applied the engine.
rules.source: programs.$id.tsx:341-346; AGENTS.md ('workflow_templates are copied into stages/criteria')

rules.rule: An engine used by at least one opportunity cannot be deleted.
A new engine is created with pass score 70%, three standard stages (approval 'supervisor', SLA 5 days) and no criteria.
Products belong to the organization catalog (grant_products.tenant_id) and are made available to a product opportunity through program_products (unique per opportunity/product).
A partner cannot request more units of a product than its current quantity_available at submission time.
Stock is deducted only at final approval (stage 3) of a product application, clamped at zero; the application then gets fulfillment_status='pending_delivery' (no contract/project).
Delivering a product application sets delivered_quantity equal to requested quantity for every item.

On transfer of an approved application: contract created only if has_contract (default true; hidden for product opportunities); project manager = default_manager_id, else first project_manager persona; plan level = application's plan level, else default_plan_level_id.
RFP details can be saved only if activity weights total 100% (when activities exist) and payment percentages total 100% (when payments exist).
The RFP opportunity budget is the financial ceiling: an offer above it is rejected in the portal.

RFP award is possible only while no offer is awarded and only on a 'pending' offer. Award sets the winner approved/awarded, closes every other pending offer as not_awarded with an automatic apology reason, transfers the winner to contract+project, and copies RFP activities and payments (amount = % x winning amount; due date = award date + due_days).

At most one invitation per opportunity and partner; invitations go only to named or group-targeted partners; email = partner email or invited email; status sent -> opened (first link open) -> applied (on submission) or declined.

Configuration of opportunities, engines and the product catalog is done in an edit session: snapshot on entry, saving requires an evidence document (note optional), cancel restores the snapshot; each commit is logged with before/after in config_edit_history.
An opportunity uses at most one form from the organization form library (grant_programs.form_id); fields are edited only in the library (see module CFG).

Stage statistics derive from application_status_history: 'submit' enters stage 1; approve_stage/skip leave to the next stage; return goes back one stage; close exits; durations are counted only for the stage the application was in.
Opportunity status 'closed' is set only manually (switch 'نشطة'); reaching close_at does not change status - open/closed is computed per BR-PRG-02.

issues.description: New opportunities are published immediately: the create flow does not set 'published' and the DB default is true, so an opportunity whose open_at has passed is instantly open to partners. There is no draft state.
issues.recommendation: Create as unpublished draft; add explicit publish step/checklist (form, criteria, targeting complete).

issues.description: No role-based permission on any PRG screen or action. Any staff persona reaching /programs (reviewer, committee_secretary, ceo) can create/edit opportunities, engines and products, publish, and award RFPs; RLS is open (shared demo account).
issues.recommendation: Restrict configuration and award to grants_manager/admin (confirm); enforce server-side.

issues.description: Deleting a catalog product is immediate (no confirmation) and cascades to application_items (FK ON DELETE CASCADE), erasing historical requests/deliveries.
issues.recommendation: Block delete when referenced; use archive/inactive flag; confirmation dialog.

issues.description: RFP award bypasses the workflow: an offer can be awarded at any stage without evaluation, pass score or committee; award runs as several non-atomic client writes (partial failure leaves inconsistent state).
issues.recommendation: Gate award on completed evaluation/approval authority; run as a single server-side transaction.

issues.description: Stock is not reserved: availability is checked only at submission and deducted at final approval with clamp to zero, so concurrent approvals can over-allocate and the shortage is silently hidden.
issues.recommendation: Check stock at approval and block/flag shortage; consider reservation at approval and release on rejection.

issues.description: Edit sessions write to live tables during editing; 'cancel' restores the snapshot (delete + reinsert / upsert). Operational changes made meanwhile (e.g., stock deduction during a catalog edit, stage changes) are overwritten; stage/criteria rows are re-created on rollback.
issues.recommendation: Use draft/staging copies and apply on commit, or restrict rollback to configuration columns.

issues.description: Criteria weights not totalling 100% and pass scores outside 0-100 can be saved (opportunity and engine).
issues.recommendation: Enforce total = 100% before publish/commit; validate pass score range.

issues.description: Basic-info save has no validation: close_at may precede open_at, budget may be 0, max per beneficiary may be 0/negative (creation flow validates dates/budget).
issues.recommendation: Reuse creation validation on save.

issues.description: Workflow structure is fixed at three stages: the engine editor only edits SLA (no add/remove/rename stage, approval type, pass score or description), the opportunity workflow tab cannot add/remove/rename stages, and lib/workflow.ts treats stage 3 as final.
issues.recommendation: Confirm whether variable stage counts are required; if so make final-stage detection data-driven.

issues.description: Applying an engine silently drops committee name/secretary and the allow_skip/edit/request_edit/attach settings, maps 'single'/'all' to 'supervisor' (distinction lost), and deletes criteria that existing evaluations may reference.
issues.recommendation: Copy all stage attributes; warn/block when evaluations exist; keep single vs all semantics or remove them from engines.

issues.description: Stages, criteria and engines can be changed while applications are in flight; there is no guard or versioning, so in-progress applications may change workflow mid-way.
issues.recommendation: Lock structural changes once applications exist, or version the workflow per application.

issues.description: Stage switches 'السماح بتعديل الطلب' (allow_edit) and 'السماح بإرفاق ملف' (allow_attach) have no observed consumer in review logic.
issues.location: programs.$id.tsx:245,247; no usage found in lib/ or reviewer.$id.tsx
issues.recommendation: Confirm intended behaviour and implement, or remove the switches.

issues.description: Multi-tenant inconsistency: the create flow inserts the constant TENANT_ID; usePrograms lists all tenants' opportunities; default stage supervisors and the Workflow-tab staff list are not tenant-filtered (Defaults tab, engines and products are).
issues.recommendation: Use the current persona's tenant consistently and filter lists by tenant.

issues.description: 'مستهدفة' (targeted) badge appears on almost every opportunity because hasTargeting counts target_types, which creation always sets; the tooltip summary ignores target_types and may read 'open to all'.
issues.recommendation: Align badge and summary logic; include account types in the summary.

issues.description: The general-opportunity flag (open_track) is set only at creation and is neither displayed nor editable later; the column is absent from the migrations (only in generated types) and from the Program interface.
issues.recommendation: Add migration, show flag on list/detail, allow edit while no applications exist.

issues.description: Dead code in the list page: an unused create() with legacy defaults plus unused state/imports (Dialog, AiAssist, kind, formRef).
issues.recommendation: Remove to avoid divergence from CreateOpportunityFlow.

issues.description: Summary tab labels stages with global STAGE_NAMES instead of the opportunity's own stage names; engine analytics compare against engine SLA, not each opportunity's (possibly edited) SLA; stage stats ignore 'award'/'merge' events.
issues.recommendation: Use actual stage rows; compute lateness per opportunity SLA; handle award/merge events.

issues.description: The publish switch on the list writes immediately, bypassing the edit-session evidence required elsewhere for opportunity changes.
issues.recommendation: Route publication through the same governance (or explicitly exempt it - confirm).

issues.description: announce_date, the free-text eligibility field and default_contract_officer_id are stored but not used by any other screen or logic found.
issues.recommendation: Confirm purpose (e.g., portal display, contract task assignment) or remove.

issues.description: The portal deep link ?apply=<id> (used after invitation acceptance) opens the application dialog without checking open window, eligibility or quota (see module PTL).
issues.recommendation: Re-validate on open and on submit; define whether invited partners may bypass the window.

issues.description: Opportunity budget is a free amount not validated against the annual plan / initiative ceiling (see module PLN).
issues.recommendation: Confirm if budget must be bound to plan availability.

issues.description: Invitations are not emailed - the demo shows an in-system copyable link only.
issues.recommendation: Integrate email/SMS delivery with templates (see CFG templates).

issues.description: Criteria and catalog rows are deleted without confirmation; existing criteria cannot be edited or reordered (only add/delete).
issues.recommendation: Add confirmation, inline edit and ordering.

issues.description: Engine apply uses a native browser confirm(); errors from delete/insert calls are not checked (partial copy possible).
issues.recommendation: Use app dialog and transactional server function.

open_questions.question: Which roles may create, edit, publish and close opportunities, maintain engines/products, send invitations and award RFPs?
Should new opportunities start as unpublished drafts, and is an approval required before publishing?
May the opportunity kind (project/product/RFP) or the general flag change after creation, and under what conditions?
Must engines support a variable number of stages and editable approval types; should engine changes propagate to opportunities (versioning)?
What happens when an engine is applied, or stages/criteria edited, while applications or evaluations exist?
When should product stock be reserved/deducted (submission, approval, delivery)? Are partial deliveries allowed?
Must eligibility be re-checked at review time (AGENTS.md states portal+review; only portal use was found)?
What are announce_date, the free-text eligibility conditions and the default contract officer used for?
Must an opportunity budget be bound to annual-plan availability of its initiative (see module PLN)?
RFP award policy: is evaluation/committee approval mandatory, is a minimum pass score required, and how are price vs score trade-offs decided?
Are invitations meant for all opportunity kinds or only RFP? May invited partners apply outside the open window or when unpublished?
Is the distinction between 'single supervisor' and 'all supervisors' approval required?
Should the quota per partner be set at creation, and which application statuses count towards it (currently all except cancelled)?
For general opportunities, may the selectable initiatives be restricted to a subset of the plan?
Should status switch automatically to closed at close_at, and what are the rules to extend or reopen an opportunity?
What business value / KPIs justify engine and product analytics (e.g., SLA compliance targets)?
